summary: Signer of the Declaration of Independence; John's 3rd cousin 8x removed via Bull Smith (formerly also 4C8R via Brewster — affected by the probable Brewster disproof).
bio: His sister Ruth married Gen. Nathaniel Woodhull. A 'Charles A. Floyd' gave $1 to the Hauppauge church in 1816 — very likely the Smithtown-born congressman, but no source connects him to the Mastic Floyds.
